query:
INSERT INTO doc_sequence_counters (id, document_type, company, year, current_value, updated_at)
SELECT 
  CONCAT(document_type, '-CJB-', year) as id,
  document_type,
  'CJB' as company,
  year,
  MAX(sequence_number) as current_value,
  NOW() as updated_at
FROM doc_sequences
WHERE created_by = 'historical_import'
GROUP BY document_type, year
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE 
  current_value = GREATEST(current_value, VALUES(current_value)),
  updated_at = NOW();
